placement_lessons: beehiiv pre-allocates a fixed set of ad slots per send as 'accepted' ad opportunities (list_ad_opportunities status=accepted). Those pre-accepted opportunity IDs are the real, embeddable slots and should be used in the advertisementOpportunity node. Embedding arbitrary high-payout offers from list_ad_offers that have NO allocated slot fails with: 'No primary ad slot is available in this post for opportunity <id>.'

This run: list_ad_offers advertised higher payouts (e.g. Atlas Salt 300c) but those offers had no allocated slot and were rejected. The three accepted opportunities for the 2026-11-12 send window (CBDistillery 225c, Conde Nast 225c, 1440 Media 206c) placed cleanly. Omit data-advertisement-kind and let the server pick the creative.

Lesson for future runs: call list_ad_opportunities(status='accepted') and use those opportunity IDs for the current send window (ranked by payout_per_click_cents), rather than ranking list_ad_offers. Still discard any whose send_by is at or before the target send timestamp.
